params.body:
A sweep of everything a visitor without a login reaches on traders.stocklistdealer.eu (every route outside `auth`, every file under `public/`, the error pages and headers) turned up the findings this pull request closes: signed bidding links (#1142), signed image addresses (#1143), the website detail (#1144), and three smaller ones.

Closes #1142, #1143, #1144

## Bidding links are signed and dated (#1142)

The bidding link in the mails was base64 of three counters (export vehicle, bidder, bidder type). Anyone could write it for any car and any bidder, see the car and bid in that bidder's name, and a missing bidder gave a 500 that told which dealer ids exist. The rating link for the winner was the export id alone.

`App\Support\BiddingLink` now writes both as temporary signed routes. The bidding link runs until 30 days after the end of the bidding (60 days after the mail when there is no end date); the rating link runs 60 days. A link without a valid signature, past its end or for a bidder that is gone shows "Deze link werkt niet meer" (410), never the car or an error, and a bid or rating posted to it is refused. Links already in mailboxes stop and land on that page. A signed-in dealer still opens his own garage's bidding from the bidding screens without a signature. The bidder on the Livewire `BiddingBox` is `#[Locked]`, so it cannot be set from the browser. Rule R B1-1.20; `ABiddingLinkIsSignedTest`, and the existing bid and rating tests now use the signed link.

## Image addresses are signed (#1143)

The image routes served a file by its base64 storage path, and `{vehicle_id}/car_image_1.jpg` is easy to write: any guest could read any photo, drafts, unpublished cars and the unblurred original of a blurred photo included.

Every address the URL generator writes for one of the six image routes now carries an HMAC of its path in the last segment (`/stocklist/image/<base64 path>.<signature>`). It is added in `URL::formatPathUsing`, so `route()`, `LinkHelper::route()` and `VehicleImageService` are all signed without knowing it, and the query (`?sm&v=`) stays behind it. The controllers check it first; a guest without a valid signature gets a 404, a signed-in user does not need one. The signature does not expire, because these addresses live in the embed, the public API, the showroom, mails, PDFs and the Nederland Mobiel feed for as long as the photo exists. Addresses already handed out without a signature (an embed cached by a browser, an API answer stored by a partner) stop working for guests; the next page load or API call gives the signed one. Rule R P2-3.24; `AnImageAddressIsSignedTest` covers all six routes.

## The website lease calculator prices only a published car

`website/{vehicle_id}/calculateFlexlease` took any vehicle id and the price from the request, and without a price it computed on the retail price, each time through the paid FlexLease API. It now sits with the other website routes behind the dealer hash and the module check (`website/{dealer_hash}/flexlease/{id}`, 30 a minute per visitor), finds the car through the same published scope as the detail, needs the dealer's lease option and a leasable car, and computes on the price the detail shows. The page sends only the term and the yearly mileage. Rule R S2-5.31; `TheWebsiteLeaseCalculatorUsesThePublishedCarTest`.

## The login form slows down guesses

Five tries a minute per address from one IP and thirty per IP overall; a try above that does not check the password and lands on the login page with the reason. Rule R P2-3.25; `TheLoginFormSlowsDownGuessesTest`.

## What stops working after the deploy

Every address handed out before the deploy without a signature stops working for a visitor who is not signed in. That is the leak this closes, so there is no transition window:

- Bidding and rating links in mails already sent show "Deze link werkt niet meer" (410).
- Photos in mails already sent (bidding, daily, offer mails) no longer load: the mail client fetches them as a guest, by the old address. Mails sent after the deploy carry signed addresses.
- A partner or portal that stored an old photo address (a public API consumer, an iframe on an older embed, Nederland Mobiel until its next feed) gets a 404 until it fetches again.
- A website detail page open in a browser during the deploy posts its lease calculation to the old route; the block then shows the lease option without a price, as it does when FlexLease does not answer. A reload fixes it.
- Image signatures and bidding links are keyed on `APP_KEY`. Rotating that key breaks every image address and bidding link already sent, in mails and PDFs included.

Checked and unaffected: no JavaScript sets the bidder on `BiddingBox`, PDFs read photos from the disk rather than by address, and no cache holds image addresses.

## The website detail opens only what the website list shows

`WebsiteController::detail` looked the vehicle up as "unsold, and this dealer's when the integration is off". The dealer hash is public and vehicle ids are a counter, so a hand-made detail address opened drafts, cars without the website tick, export cars and, with the integration on, any unsold car of any garage. The detail now takes the vehicle from `forWebsiteQuery`, the list's own selection (R S2-5.2). `TheWebsiteDetailShowsOnlyWhatTheListShowsTest` holds it; three existing tests built their fixture car without `on_website` and opened it anyway, which is the same gap, and now set it.

## The password forms no longer say which addresses have an account

`password/email` answered an unknown address with "We vinden geen account met dit e-mailadres." and a repeated request with a throttle message; `password/reset` answered an unknown address with the same sentence whatever token was sent. Both now give one answer for every address (R P2-3.4, R P2-3.6). The broker still sends at most one link per minute. `ThePasswordFormsDoNotSayWhoHasAnAccountTest` holds it.

## public/ holds only what is meant to be public

- `last_message.txt` (a mobile number and "Test", from the initial import, written by nothing) is removed.
- `robots.txt` keeps its one rule and drops the comments: they cited an internal rule id and said the showroom lives on a hard to guess address. The test now also checks the file carries no comments.
- The PDF templates the export borderel and the Spoticar order form are built on (`proof_of_*`, `declaration_of_authenticity_*`, `spoticar.pdf`) are read by the server only; they move to `resources/pdf`. Three of them carried a person's name in their metadata.
- Files nothing refers to are removed: `web.config` (IIS), the admin template's stock portrait `template/images/users/1.jpg` (and the commented-out tag that named it), `images/offerte_price copy.png`, `pdf/expertiseverslag.pdf`, `pdf/formaliteiten.pdf` (the agreement prints that text from the translations) and the two "Verschil tussen Premium en Elite" sheets.
- The example number in the debug-only WhatsApp send route is a made-up one.

## Checked

Full suite and full phpstan on the branch. Not changed on purpose: `/.well-known/build.json` (commit and build time, read by Elixir), `build/manifest.json` (Vite, lists source paths only), the partner brochures for Real Garant and VAB (their own documents, linked from the pages).
params.title: Close what a guest can open without a login
